segments.caption: A man is driving a car along a tree-lined road, speaking to the camera. The video cuts to a low-angle shot of a car's wheel on a wet, leaf-strewn road, then back to the driver. The scene shifts to a white car parked on the side of the road, followed by a title card from "Which?" that reads "How to use a tyre repair kit," indicating the video is an instructional guide on fixing a flat tyre. A man approaches his white car parked on a residential street and inspects the front wheel, which appears to be flat, prompting him to take action. He then enters the vehicle and presses the passenger airbag disable button, likely as a safety precaution before attempting a repair. The video, presented by Which? and titled "How to use a tyre repair kit," sets up a scenario where the man is preparing to use a repair kit to fix the flat tyre.

A man inspects a white car, starting with a close-up of the illuminated interior power button and airbag warning lights, then moving outside to examine the tire, and finally opening the trunk, suggesting he is checking the vehicle's condition or preparing for a task.
A man inspects a flat tire on his white Toyota, then retrieves a portable tire sealant and compressor kit from the trunk to fix the puncture on the spot.

A man retrieves a portable tire compressor and sealant bottle from his car’s trunk and proceeds to use them to fix a flat tire on the rear wheel, connecting the compressor to the sealant bottle before applying it to the valve stem.

A man crouches by his white car, using a portable compressor to inflate a flat tire. He connects the compressor to the tire valve, then plugs its power cord into the car’s 12V socket to power it, demonstrating a convenient solution for roadside tire inflation.

A man crouches beside his white car, using a portable tire inflator to fix a flat tire. He plugs the device's power cord into the car's 12V socket, then presses a button on the inflator to begin pumping air into the tire, restoring its pressure and getting the vehicle back on the road.
A person uses a portable air compressor to inflate a flat tire on a white car parked on a leaf-strewn cobblestone street, after which the car drives away.

A man drives a white car through an autumnal urban and suburban setting, speaking to the camera as he navigates streets lined with fallen leaves and trees, with a “Subscribe to our channel” graphic appearing on screen.
A man drives a white car along a tree-lined road, speaking to the camera as he navigates the scenic, leaf-strewn street.

A man is driving a car along a tree-lined road, speaking to the camera as he navigates. The video cuts to external shots of the car, a white Toyota, driving through a park-like setting. The segment concludes with a promotional screen for the consumer organization "Which?", offering a trial for £1 on services related to tyres and breakdowns.

A static promotional advertisement from Which? remains on screen, offering a one-month trial for just £1. The ad highlights three key services: finding the best buy tyres, tips on how to save money on tyres, and a list of recommended breakdown companies.
